limitations: Only overlapping closed boxes and one box with one construction plane are sampled.
Native selected-cell keys are not API bRepCells array indices; available-cell order varies between runs.
Observed body group one matches inside and group two outside only for the sampled closed boxes.
Plane side flag semantics, general open-surface membership and persistent face-to-ASM mapping remain unresolved.
NewComponent creates component wrappers and normalizes the actual Boundary Fill feature operation to NewBody.
The decoder retains primary descriptors but leaves the observed NewComponent occurrence proxy context opaque.
Boolean cell generation, exact cell-boundary reconstruction and native file writing are not implemented.
